info.description: The MusicBrainz API provides developers with access to the MusicBrainz Database, an extensive collection of music metadata. Designed for media applications like players and taggers, it utilizes REST principles and supports content in XML and JSON formats for easy integration.
info.title: MusicBrainz API
info.tagline: Query the open MusicBrainz music metadata database for artists, releases, recordings and related entities
info.license_short: Database is community-maintained and openly licensed; data licences vary (see MusicBrainz data licences). Commercial use requires contacting MetaBrainz.

info.about_md:
[MusicBrainz](https://musicbrainz.org/) is an open, community-maintained encyclopedia of music metadata operated by the [MetaBrainz Foundation](https://metabrainz.org/). The web service at `https://musicbrainz.org/ws/2/` exposes the database as a REST API returning XML or JSON, designed for media players, taggers, CD rippers and similar applications.

What you get from the API:

- **Lookup** a single entity by its MusicBrainz Identifier (MBID).
- **Browse** entities linked to another entity (e.g. releases by an artist).
- **Search** with Lucene-style queries across the catalogue.
- **Non-MBID lookups** by `discid`, `ISRC` or `ISWC`.
- **Submission** of tags, ratings, barcodes and ISRCs via authenticated POST.

Operational notes:

- Strict rate limit: at most **one request per second** per client/IP — exceeding this can lead to blocking.
- Set a descriptive `User-Agent` identifying your application and contact info.
- Authentication uses **OAuth2** or HTTP digest over HTTPS for user-specific reads and submissions; anonymous access is fine for most lookups.

entity_desc.area: A geographic area (country, city, subdivision) used to place artists, labels and events — `/area/{mbid}`.
entity_desc.artist: A musician, group, orchestra or other performing entity — `/artist/{mbid}`.
entity_desc.collection: A user-curated set of entities (non-core resource) — `/collection/{mbid}`.
entity_desc.event: A concert, festival or other music event — `/event/{mbid}`.
entity_desc.instrument: A musical instrument used in recordings or by artists — `/instrument/{mbid}`.
entity_desc.label: A record label or imprint that issues releases — `/label/{mbid}`.
entity_desc.place: A specific venue, studio or other physical place — `/place/{mbid}`.
entity_desc.rating: User ratings attached to core entities (non-core resource), submittable via authenticated POST.
entity_desc.recording: A distinct audio recording (a track as performed/captured) — `/recording/{mbid}`.
entity_desc.recording_list: A list result of recordings, e.g. from browse or search queries on recordings.
entity_desc.release: A specific issuance of an album, single or other product (with format, country, date) — `/release/{mbid}`.
entity_desc.release_group: An abstract grouping of related releases (e.g. all editions of an album) — `/release-group/{mbid}`.
entity_desc.release_list: A list result of releases, e.g. from browse or search queries on releases.
entity_desc.series: An ordered series of releases, recordings, works or events — `/series/{mbid}`.
entity_desc.tag: Free-form folksonomy tags applied to entities (non-core resource), submittable via authenticated POST.
entity_desc.url: A URL resource linking entities to external web pages — `/url/{mbid}`.
entity_desc.work: A distinct musical work or composition, separate from any one recording — `/work/{mbid}`.
entity_desc.work_list: A list result of works, e.g. from browse or search queries on works.
